big_tech.title: Software Engineering Intern
big_tech.company_description: World's largest search and cloud infrastructure company.
big_tech.fit_explanation: Your Python, C++, and PyTorch experience maps well to Google's SWE intern roles across infrastructure and ML teams. UMich is a strong Google feeder school with dedicated recruiting events.

big_tech.title: Software Engineering Intern

big_tech.fit_explanation: UMich CS is a strong Meta feeder school. Your React and TypeScript skills are directly applicable to their product engineering teams, and your Citadel internship signals strong execution under pressure.

big_tech.title: Software Engineering Intern — Payments
big_tech.company_description: Global payments infrastructure company processing hundreds of billions annually.
big_tech.fit_explanation: Your Citadel fintech background combined with TypeScript and Python maps well to Stripe's payments infrastructure teams. Stripe actively recruits candidates with both finance and engineering depth.

startup.title: Software Engineering Intern
startup.company_description: Corporate card and spend management platform, $8.1B valuation and fastest-growing fintech SaaS.
startup.fit_explanation: Ramp's TypeScript-heavy stack maps directly to your skills, and your Citadel experience gives you fintech credibility that stands out in their applicant pool. Strong conversion from intern to full-time.

startup.title: Software Engineering Intern
startup.company_description: Defense tech company building autonomous systems, Series E at $8.5B valuation.
startup.fit_explanation: High-performance C++ and Python at scale in a mission-critical domain — directly maps to your systems background. Anduril recruits heavily from top CS programs including UMich.

startup.title: Quantitative Developer Intern
startup.company_description: Travel rebooking platform using ML for real-time flight optimization, YC-backed Series A.
startup.fit_explanation: Bridges your Citadel quant work with startup pace — Python and ML focus in a consumer fintech context. Small team means real ownership and direct mentorship from founders.

reach.title: Software Engineering Intern
reach.company_description: Leading global market maker and one of the most selective SWE intern programs in finance.
reach.fit_explanation: Your Citadel internship is a direct credential — Citadel Securities actively converts Citadel LLC interns. Your Python, C++, and quant background is the exact profile they target.
reach.reach_gap: Citadel Securities is extremely competitive even with Citadel LLC experience. To strengthen your candidacy: push your LeetCode hard pass rate above 90% and ship one open-source quant or systems project you can discuss in depth during their technical screen.

reach.title: Software Engineering Intern
reach.company_description: Elite systematic trading firm known for low-latency systems and exceptional SWE comp.
reach.fit_explanation: Your C++ background and quant finance interest make you a credible candidate — HRT values both. Your Citadel experience signals you can handle fast-moving, high-stakes engineering environments.
reach.reach_gap: HRT cares deeply about systems programming depth. Close the gap by building one low-latency or OS-level project in C++ — something that demonstrates you understand memory layout, cache behavior, or network performance.
